correctness.rationale: For all integers \(a,b\ge1\), \(k\ge2\), and nonnegative integer lifespans, the exact side-count lemma and side-symmetric choice provide enough independent uniform labeled draws for an alternating stationary single walk. The single walk is marginally correct because the chosen side is fair and independent of label arrays. Collaborative walkers use disjoint independent coordinates, so their independence is preserved. Every single-walk label is drawn from the union pool. The actual packaged checker passed 20729 finite exact tests; the proof is analytic.

value.rationale: The result solves the explicit stochastic-domination challenge on every complete bipartite graph with arbitrarily many independent stationary walkers and budgets. It establishes labeled-set inclusion, not just an expectation inequality, and shows unrestricted-parity behavior in the natural periodic family. The structural coupon-pool construction explains the effect.
